'''SM-5''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] controlled [[Droid/Legends|droid]] onboard the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[Steadfast (carrier)|''Steadfast'']], and was used to search destroyed vessels for traps before being salvaged. In [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]] SM-5 was one of the droids involved in the finding of a operational datacore on the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Gnisnal]]'' that allowed for the discovery of the [[Black Fleet]].
